name: heap_tree.k
model:
class TreeNode {
  var value:Int
  var left:TreeNode
  var right:TreeNode
}

var root:TreeNode

req root.value = 1

req root.left.value = 2

req root.right.value = 3

req root != root.left

req root != root.right

req root.left != root.right
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (root Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((TreeNode (mk-TreeNode (value Int)(left Ref)(right Ref)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-TreeNode (sel-TreeNode TreeNode))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-TreeNode ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TreeNode (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TreeNode ((this Ref)) TreeNode
  (sel-TreeNode (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-TreeNode ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TreeNode this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.root: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!root ((this Ref)) Ref
  (root (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; -------------------------------
;   Getters for class TreeNode:
; -------------------------------

; --- getters for TreeNode.value: ---

(define-fun TreeNode.value ((this Ref)) Int
  (value (deref-TreeNode this))
)

; --- getters for TreeNode.left: ---

(define-fun TreeNode.left ((this Ref)) Ref
  (left (deref-TreeNode this))
)

(define-fun TreeNode!left ((this Ref)) Ref
  (left (deref-TreeNode this))
)

; --- getters for TreeNode.right: ---

(define-fun TreeNode.right ((this Ref)) Ref
  (right (deref-TreeNode this))
)

(define-fun TreeNode!right ((this Ref)) Ref
  (right (deref-TreeNode this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-TreeNode (TopLevelDeclarations!root this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TreeNode.value (TopLevelDeclarations!root this)) 1)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TreeNode.value (TreeNode.left (TopLevelDeclarations!root this))) 2)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TreeNode.value (TreeNode.right (TopLevelDeclarations!root this))) 3)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (TopLevelDeclarations!root this) (TreeNode.left (TopLevelDeclarations!root this))))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 0) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (TopLevelDeclarations!root this) (TreeNode.right (TopLevelDeclarations!root this))))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 0) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 7: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (TreeNode.left (TopLevelDeclarations!root this)) (TreeNode.right (TopLevelDeclarations!root this))))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv7 0) :named _xkassert6))



; ---------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TreeNode:
; ---------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-TreeNode TreeNode)
(declare-const const-2-TreeNode TreeNode)
(declare-const const-3-TreeNode TreeNode)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TreeNode.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-TreeNode (TreeNode!left this))
)

(assert (! (TreeNode.inv1 1) :named _xkassert7))
(assert (! (TreeNode.inv1 2) :named _xkassert8))
(assert (! (TreeNode.inv1 3) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TreeNode.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-TreeNode (TreeNode!right this))
)

(assert (! (TreeNode.inv2 1) :named _xkassert10))
(assert (! (TreeNode.inv2 2) :named _xkassert11))
(assert (! (TreeNode.inv2 3) :named _xkassert12))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-TreeNode const-1-TreeNode))
        2 (lift-TreeNode const-2-TreeNode))
        3 (lift-TreeNode const-3-TreeNode))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-2-TreeNode () TreeNode
  (mk-TreeNode 2 3 3))
(define-fun const-1-TreeNode () TreeNode
  (mk-TreeNode 1 2 3))
(define-fun const-3-TreeNode () TreeNode
  (mk-TreeNode 3 3 2))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (left (sel-TreeNode (select heap 1))))))
  (is-lift-TreeNode a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (root (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
(let ((a!2 (sel-TreeNode (select heap (left (sel-TreeNode a!1))))))
  (= (value a!2) 2))))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (root (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
(let ((a!2 (= (root (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))
              (right (sel-TreeNode a!1)))))
  (not a!2))))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (left (sel-TreeNode (select heap 3))))))
  (is-lift-TreeNode a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (root (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-TreeNode a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (left (sel-TreeNode (select heap 2))))))
  (is-lift-TreeNode a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (right (sel-TreeNode (select heap 1))))))
  (is-lift-TreeNode a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert12 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (right (sel-TreeNode (select heap 3))))))
  (is-lift-TreeNode a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (root (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
(let ((a!2 (sel-TreeNode (select heap (right (sel-TreeNode a!1))))))
  (= (value a!2) 3))))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (right (sel-TreeNode (select heap 2))))))
  (is-lift-TreeNode a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (root (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (not (= (left (sel-TreeNode a!1)) (right (sel-TreeNode a!1))))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (root (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (value (sel-TreeNode a!1)) 1)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (root (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
(let ((a!2 (= (root (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))
              (left (sel-TreeNode a!1)))))
  (not a!2))))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
                  1
                  (lift-TreeNode (mk-TreeNode 1 2 3)))))
  (store (store a!1 2 (lift-TreeNode (mk-TreeNode 2 3 3)))
         3
         (lift-TreeNode (mk-TreeNode 3 3 2)))))
(define-fun k!heap_full!TreeNode () Bool
  true)
